energy_network.loop_replenishment: Orb continues to supply the same logical network; do not create a second energy source.

layers.visual_role: 主能量路径与主传播脉冲

layers.optics_resource: Independent alpha, liquid crest, edge glint and environment refraction; must preserve source photo pixels.
layers.motion_resource: Primary path phase and pulse, bottom-center split, side ascent, top-center convergence and seamless perimeter loop.

gpu_render_order.reason: Broad soft water volume establishes depth behind the primary flow.
Primary flow remains visually dominant over the veil.
Fine gold network stays legible above the broader layers.
Sparse optical details sit above the ribbons without hiding the photo.

motion_contract.clock: Use the single existing global motion clock defined by the global visual-motion contract.

keyframes.behavior: Orb Core emits the single logical Task Energy network toward the photo.
Energy arrives at the real photo bottom-center and creates contact response.
The same flow splits left and right along the photo bottom edge.
Both branches climb the true rounded side paths.
Both branches converge at top center and continue propagating.
All four layers continuously traverse the complete closed perimeter with no visible seam or global reset.

layer_motion.L1: Primary continuous path, pulse and propagation.
layer_motion.L2: Follows L1 with an independent phase and slight delay.
layer_motion.L3: Asynchronous variable branches, merges and local energy accents.
layer_motion.L4: Independent particle speed and lifetime along the real flow direction.

kf06_requirements: left and right branches form one complete closed path
top convergence continues through the loop
position, tangent velocity and phase remain continuous at the seam
Orb replenishes the same logical energy network
